newsitem.title: USA: Farmers okay Pacific Northwest milk order changes.
newsitem.headline: Farmers okay Pacific Northwest milk order changes.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Friday said dairy farmers have approved the addition of two counties to the Pacific Northwest federal milk order marketing area.
USDA said the producers also okayed changing the pricing plan to incorporate three components, protein, other nonfat solids and butterfat, instead of just nonfat solids and butterfat.
A USDA official said as cheese becomes a more important product in the Pacific Northwest marketing area, it was appropriate to reflect the value of protein in the pricing plan.
The amended order will become effective Feb. 1.
